_meta.note: EXAMPLE operator policy. ./setup.sh copies this to data/policy.json — YOUR boundaries. Travel/office/relocation commitments and the attestation classes below are adjudicated against these values; anything over the caps parks for your judgment. HOW THIS IS WIRED: the open-repo prescreen parks travel/office/relocation commitments for the applicant's explicit answer (fail-closed) — it never invents a % cap or day count for you. Record your caps here so you — and any execution layer you run — answer consistently and truthfully.

hard_stop_classes: no_ai_or_unaided_work — would be FALSE if an agent answered; always parks
travel_office_relocation_commitments — adjudicated against the caps above; anything over parks
essays — require your own words; always parks
unknown_facts — anything only you could know (exact dates, proprietary details); parks for your answer
attestations.preauthorized_note: Standard legal attestations YOU genuinely agree to (arbitration agreement, background-check consent, at-will acknowledgment, information-truthfulness, data-privacy consent) are pre-authorized ONLY via attestation_scope.preauthorized_attestation_keys in your answer_bank.json — never here, never by default. The open-repo prescreen parks ALL attestations fail-closed; pre-authorization is a standing decision your execution layer enforces from the answer bank.

office.note: Maximum in-office days/week you accept. Roles demanding 4-5 days/week or full-time on-site park. An unspecified office frequency is treated as acceptable unless your note says otherwise.

relocation.note: If false, any relocation requirement parks. If true, name the regions so relocation questions answer truthfully.
regions: YOUR acceptable regions, e.g. anywhere / your metro only

examples: ExampleCorp excludes ExampleState residents — adapt to your state
state_exclusions.note: Postings that explicitly exclude hires in YOUR state are permanent eligibility blocks, not your call. List patterns here; they mirror engines/prescreen.py's STATE_EXCLUSION_RES (operator-local edit, never committed).

travel.note: Maximum travel you accept, on a DEFINED schedule. Generic, regular, unspecified, or open-ended travel is never mapped to a number — it parks for your judgment.
